references.text: The laws concerning impurity from touching dead animals and how the impurity lasts until evening, paralleling the principle that impurity is transmitted by touch and lasts until evening.
Rules on how impurity spreads through contact with an unclean person or object, and that whoever touches becomes unclean until evening.
The context of impurity from contact with dead bodies, which forms the basis for the entire chapter's purification ritual.
Priests who are unclean must not eat of the holy offerings until they are clean, and they become clean at sunset.
The prophet Haggai asks the priests about the transmission of impurity by touch, illustrating the same principle that impurity is contagious.
